cases.case_label: Founder 3 kb retrotransposal insertion in FKTN 3' non-coding region (Brazil)
cases.mechanism_detail: Patient carries one copy of the founder 3 kb retrotransposal insertion in the fukutin 3' non-coding region; no second mutation was found in the exons/flanking introns. Mechanism not investigated.
cases.quote: The fukutin gene study showed one founder 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in the 3'-non-coding region, and in the other allele no mutation was detected after screening all exons and flanking introns by sequencing.
